title: Oracle November 2026 Critical Security Patch Update fixes hundreds of flaws including Java4Shell
summary: Oracle's November Critical Security Patch Update has 655 new patches, per Oracle's advisory. SecurityWeek counts 948 unique CVEs, 640 of them in risk matrices, with about 300 unauthenticated and remotely exploitable and 62 critical. Hyperion has the most fixes (267). Java SE includes the fix for Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938). No exploitation is reported for the other flaws.
plain: Oracle released its big quarterly security update, fixing hundreds of flaws across its products, including the serious Java flaw known as Java4Shell.
exec: A large quarterly patch load across Oracle products; Java4Shell is already on file as urgent.
action: Schedule the November 2026 CSPU: patch Java SE first for Java4Shell, then internet-facing Oracle products with unauthenticated flaws.

key_findings: 655 new patches; SecurityWeek counts 948 unique CVEs.
